biography.bio:
A rugged big-rig driver who handles the team's heaviest hauler like a sports car.

Masks: Totem (wearing Totem).

Vehicles: @UUID[Compendium.essence20-homebrew-starter.mask_vehicles.Actor.yXvFAessSAM98418]{Goliath II}.

M.A.S.K. - M.A.S.K. homebrew; stats built with the Threat Builder (Field Guide rules).

system.description:
Launches small totem-shaped projectiles that hit hard.

Nevada Rushmore's mask. Bonded to the first agent who puts it on: for them, it gives +1 Toughness and its power works a number of times per scene equal to their Speed. One mask at a time.

automation.notes: Rolls against the targets and posts Apply Damage buttons (x degrees of success) and any Condition on a hit. Speed uses per scene and +1 Toughness, only for the bonded wearer (Power Gear: bonded, mask slot).

system.description:
You have reinforced your helmet. While you wear a mask, you have +1 Toughness on top of the helmet's own.

M.A.S.K. homebrew.

automation.notes: Automatic: +1 Toughness while you wear a mask.

system.description:
You know your ride like your own hands. A vehicle you are driving has +1 Evasion and Edge on its Driving Tests.

M.A.S.K. homebrew.

automation.notes: Automatic: the vehicle you drive gets +1 Evasion, and its Driving Tests have Edge.
